record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

And thou shalt make<WH06213><WTH8804> the staves<WH0905> <FI>of<Fi> shittim<WH07848> wood<WH06086>, and overlay<WH06823><WTH8765> them with gold<WH02091>, that the table<WH07979> may be borne<WH05375><WTH8738> with them.

<FI> Of<Fi> a talent<WH03603> of pure<WH02889> gold<WH02091> shall he make<WH06213><WTH8799> it, with all these vessels<WH03627>.
